concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-transfer-transactions]] — 2026-09-15 balance-platform transaction tracking hub for transfer status meanings, webhook/API routes and failed/refused/returned handling; booked source debit is not bank receipt.
warnings: The status table describes transfer lifecycle; transaction webhook details and query schema live in linked child guides.
A booked source-account deduction does not prove beneficiary-bank receipt; bank returns can arrive days later with original-account credit and separate report entry.
The hub does not authorize retrying a failed/refused or returned transfer automatically.
